origin: Far below the surface, where neither light nor hope can reach, the Leviathan waits.
story: It does not chase its prey. It lets the weight of the deep crush them first. Those who panic are swallowed. Those who remain steady rise again.
quotes: Do not break. The abyss rewards only those who keep moving.
unlockText: The weight of the deep is patient. It has been waiting for you specifically.
victoryText: You surfaced. The Leviathan sinks back into water that no longer remembers your name.
rule: Never put the kettlebells down during the Front Rack Carry. Carry the weight, or let it carry you.
hunterAdvice: Do not break. The abyss rewards only those who keep moving.
